annotations.title: Marchés publics attribués à une entreprise française (DECP)

description: List the public contracts awarded to ONE French company, from its 9-digit SIREN (or 14-digit SIRET), in the official DECP open data (Données essentielles de la commande publique, consolidated files on data.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte 2.0) over the last 24 monthly files. Returns `synthese` (number of distinct contracts, total notified amount in euros, first and last notification date, number of distinct public buyers), `parAnnee` (contracts and amount per notification year), `parSecteurCpv` (top 5 CPV divisions with their French label), `marchesRecents` (up to 10 latest awards: id, buyer SIRET, subject, CPV code, procedure, amount, date, department), `source` (name, licence, last update date to cite when reusing the data) and `avertissements` (reading limits), signed with an Ed25519 attestation. Amounts: negative amounts or amounts above 10 billion euros are excluded from the sums (and counted in `avertissements`). A contract awarded to a group is counted in full for each member identified by SIRET. Only contractors identified by SIRET are covered; foreign contractors are not. A company with no published public contract returns a valid answer with zeros (`nombreMarches: 0`): it is charged, because 'no public contract published in the last 24 months' is itself the information. The data is self-reported by buyers and incomplete: no contract does not prove no public business. No personal data: for a sole trader (entrepreneur individuel) the subject of the contracts (`objet`) is never returned. When to use another tool: for the identity, status, insolvency and verdict of the company use verifier_entreprise; if you only know the name, call rechercher_entreprise first. Errors (never charged): an invalid SIREN is rejected before any payment request; if the DECP copy is not loaded yet (first start of the service) the call returns an error and is not settled, retry a few minutes later. Payment: $0.02 per call via x402 (USDC on Base). No account or API key.

siren.description: 9-digit SIREN of the company (Luhn-valid); a 14-digit SIRET is also accepted. Spaces, dots and dashes are accepted.
